reports.persona: 70-year-old grandfather who loves to tell stories
reports.scenario_hint: About 250-300 words about grandkids, the weather, parking at the hospital, the TV show; ONE symptom buried in the middle: threw up once after lunch.
reports.text: well it was a long one actually. the grandkids came over to see the goldfish again, little sammy kept trying to feed them crackers, you know how they are, so dizzy and all that. had to explain that fish don't eat bread, they get the gills all clogged up, reminded me of when i dropped my pipe down the drain in '98, took me an hour to get it back, old rags and a wire hanger, but we digress. weather has been so damp lately, that grey mist that gets into your joints, my knees feel like rusty hinges, really do. but the real headache was dropping them off at st. vincent for their physicals, i swear they changed the parking layout again, nothing marked, just cones and confusion, i circled the block three times looking for the handicap spot, saw a taxi driver sitting in it eating a sandwich, i wanted to shout at him but i was too tired. went in to wait anyway, sat in that uncomfortable plastic chair with the armrests broken. turned on the news but it was just rain again, so i put on that show with the detective, the one with the old dog, really good acting, quite moving actually. then i went home, had a bit of lunch, just toast and some tea maybe. and right after, felt a wave come on, kinda heavy in the stomach, and then i threw up once, just once, into the sink. wiped it up, drank some water, sat on the couch for a while. not great but manageable i guess. anyway, sammy sent a drawing of his daddy, pretty good, two eyes and a smile, i put it on the fridge. hope you are all well. bob.

reports.persona: 70-year-old grandfather who loves to tell stories
reports.scenario_hint: About 250-300 words rambling about his garden and neighbours; buried in the middle: nausea in the evening and skipped dinner.
reports.text: morning here. the roses are doing alright, the ruddy ones by the gate are blooming nice, really happy about that, but the hydrangeas are a mess, all droopy and brown on the edges, i think the bees took everything they could get. spent half the day out there with the hose, trying not to overdo it because my back gets cranky if i bend too long, got my knee brace on just in case. neighbor harry is up to his usual tricks, i hear him mowing the lawn at seven in the morning, that loud engine really grates on me, makes the whole street shake, i waved but he didn't even look up, typical harry, thinks the whole world revolves around his perfect hedge. i waved at mary next door, she gave me a bowl of zucchini, too many zucchini, i have a fridge full of them now, dont know what to do with them, maybe zucchini bread if i have the energy later. afternoon was quiet, just sat on the porch reading the paper, the news is terrible as usual but i try to look on the bright side. evening came in and the air turned cold, got a bit of a queasy feeling in the middle of the evening, kind of a rolling motion in the stomach, not exactly throwing up but enough to make me not want to touch the food. so i skipped dinner, just had a dry cracker and some water, felt better after that. went to bed early, slept like a rock, woke up early this morning. anyway, the garden needs weeding but i might wait until tomorrow, its too windy today for it.
